blocks.value: What is NEET SS 2025?

NEET SS or National Eligibility cum Entrance Test (Super Speciality Courses) is conducted by the National Board of Education for admission to various DM/ MCh and DNB courses. It is a qualifying-cum-ranking examination for admission to medical super-speciality courses. According to the Indian Medical Council Act, 2016, no other entrance test is valid for admission to these courses. The duration of the NEET SS exam will be 150 minutes or 2.5 hours. The first shift will be conducted from 9 AM to 11.30 AM, and the second shift will be conducted from 2 PM to 4.30 PM.

• All DM/MCh Courses in the country including all Private Medical Colleges/Institutions/Universities/Deemed Universities.
• All DM/MCh courses at Armed Forces Medical Services Institutions
• All DrNB Super-specialty Courses (except Direct 6 Years DrNB Courses

Foreign nationals who wish to pursue a super-speciality course in India need to appear for the NEET SS 2025 examination and clear it. Such candidates do not need to be registered with the MCI/ SMC, provided he/ she is duly registered with the appropriate authority in his/ her own country.

On securing a seat through NEET SS, the MCI may grant temporary registration to these candidates for the duration of the postdoctoral course. This registration will be temporary and will be limited to the medical college/ institution to which he/she is admitted.

NEET SS Exam Pattern 2025

NBE released the NEET SS 2025 exam pattern along with the information bulletin on November 5. NEET SS is the postgraduate super-speciality medical entrance exam conducted in a computer-based mode for 2.5 hours or 150 minutes. There are 15 groups or super-speciality subjects that are tested, and candidates have to choose their question paper groups during the application process. The papers are scheduled in such a way that there is no clash of exam dates or slots. There will be a total of three sections in the paper, carrying 50 questions. The sectional time limit for each section is 50 minutes. NBE had introduced the sectional time limits last year, and this pattern is being followed this year as well.

Explaining the time-bound sections, NBEMS stated, "Candidates will be restricted from proceeding to the next section until they complete the allotted time for the previous section. Additionally, candidates will not be allowed to review the questions or modify their responses for a section after the completion of its allotted time. The questions for the next section will start automatically after the completion of the allotted time for the previous section."
Each question carries four marks and for each wrong answer, there will be a negative marking of one mark for each wrong answer. The full marks of the NEET SS exam is 600.

NEET SS exam paper comprises questions from the general/basic components of the primary feeder broad speciality subject and from all sub-specialities/systems/components of that primary feeder broad speciality subject.

faqs.question: What is the total number of questions in NEET SS?
faqs.answer: According to the latest exam pattern of NEET SS, there are 150 multiple-choice questions, from broad speciality and super speciality course. There will be three time-bound sections of 50 minutes each, carrying 50 questions. The question paper is of 600 marks.  The question paper will consist of questions from the General/Basic component of the primary feeder broad specialty subject and from all sub-specialty/systems/component of that primary feeder broad specialty subject. All the 150 questions would be from the Curriculum of the Post Graduate Exit level of the primary feeder broad specialty subject. Candidates will get two-and-a-half hours to attempt the questions.

faqs.question: What is a feeder course in NEET SS exam?
faqs.answer: In NEET SS exam, feeder course refers to the broad speciality qualifications, under which the courses are grouped. According to NBEMS, the question papers of these groups will consist of questions from the General/Basic component of the respective primary feeder broad specialty subject and from all sub-specialty/ systems/component of that primary feeder broad specialty subject. All the questions would be from the Curriculum of the Post Graduate Exit level of the primary feeder broad specialty subject.

faqs.question: Does NBE provide correction facility for NEET SS?

faqs.question: What was date for NEET SS 2025 exam?

faqs.question: What is the NEET SS Exam?
faqs.answer: NEET SS or National Eligibility cum Entrance Test (Super Speciality Courses) is conducted by the National Board of Education for admission to various DM/ M.Ch. Courses. It is a qualifying cum ranking examination for admission to super speciality courses. For appearing in NEET SS, aspirants should hold a postgraduate degree (MD/MS/DNB) or any equivalent examination. By qualifying the exam, candidates can take admission in speciality courses. According to the Indian Medical Council Act, 2016, no other entrance test is valid for admission to these courses. NEET SS is conducted annually in computer-based mode.

faqs.question: What is the total duration of the NEET SS exam?
faqs.answer: The total duration of the NEET SS exam is 150 minutes or 2.5 hours. There is a sectional time limit of 50 minutes for each of the three sections. Hence, candidates have to manage the time accordingly to attempt as many number of questions as possible within this duration. There are 150 questions in total and 50 questions in each section. Hence, to attempt all the questions, test-takers will get one minute per question. Along with maintaining to speed to complete the NEET SS exam, candidates must also maintain accuracy to avoid losing marks since there is a negative marking scheme.

faqs.question: What is the difference between the NEET SS demo test and the actual exam?
faqs.answer: There are certain differences in the NEET SS demo test and the actual NEET SS exam. As NBEMS has introduced time-bound sections for NEET SS, it has also provided a NEET SS demo test to help candidates get accustomed to the new pattern or structure. Unlike the actual exam, the total duration of the NEET SS demo test is 15 minutes, wherein five minutes is allotted to each section. The total number of questions in each section is five. Moreover, the questions of the NEET SS demo test are not as per the syllabus,   On the other hand, the NEET SS exam is of 150 minutes, duration carrying 150 questions from three sections, The section-wise duration in minutes and number of questions will be 50.

faqs.question: What is the syllabus for the NEET SS Exam?
faqs.answer: There is no fixed syllabus for NEET SS. The questions can be asked from all the topics that have been covered during both, the undergraduate and postgraduate qualifications. However the subjects that need to be prepared will be limited to the feeder course and super speciality course selected by the candidate Paediatric Cardio thoracic Vascular Surgery Thoracic Surgery Cardio Vascular and Thoracic Surgery Vascular Surgery Hepato Pancreato Biliary Surgery Surgical Gastroenterology Paediatric Hepatology Paediatric Oncology Paediatric Nephrology Paediatric Cardiology Paediatric Gastroenterology Neonatology Paediatric and Neonatal Anaesthesia Organ Transplant Anaesthesia and Critical CareCardiac Anesthesia.

faqs.question: Is there any negative marking in NEET SS Exam?
faqs.answer: There is negative marking in the NEET SS exam. Each wrong answer results in deduction of one mark. However, no marks are deducted for unanswered questions. Candidates get four marks for each correct answer.

faqs.question: What is the marking scheme of the NEET SS exam?
faqs.answer: Each question of NEET SS carries four marks. For each wrong answer, one mark is deducted. No marks is deducted or awarded for questions left unanswered in the NEET SS exam.

faqs.question: What is the process to take the NEET SS demo test?
faqs.answer: The NEET SS Demo Test can be accessed by following the steps given below. Visit the official website of NEET SS – natboard.edu.in Click on NEET SS under the Examinations section Click on the Application tab Click on the link next to Demo Test Click on Sign In Read the instructions and click on 'I Agree' checkbox Click on 'I am Ready to Begin' tab Click on the answer options and click on 'Save & Next' You may also click on 'Mark for Review' or 'Clear Responses' if you want to rethink or re-attempt the answer.

faqs.question: What is the mode of the NEET SS counselling?
faqs.answer: The NEET SS counselling process is conducted by the Medical Counselling Committee (MCC) primarily in online mode. All the steps of the counselling process, including the registration, release of seat matrix, choice filling and locking, and release of the seat allotment result. Only the last and final round, which is the institute reporting, has to be done in offline mode. Herein candidates who have been allotted seats have to visit the institutes for document verification and complete the admission process by paying the requisite fee amount.

faqs.question: Which body conducts the NEET SS counselling?
faqs.answer: The NEET SS counselling is conducted by the Medical Counselling Committee (MCC) for the 100 per cent All India Quota (AIQ) seats of the M.Ch, DNB and DrNB courses. Candidates have to participate in the NEET SS counselling process is an online mode, by visiting the official website and completing the processes such as registration, choice filling and locking, and checking of the seat allotment result. The final step, which is institute reporting, is done at an institute level.

faqs.question: What are the prohibited items at NEET SS exam centre?
faqs.answer: The following items will be prohibited from being carried to the NEET SS exam centre: · Any stationery item like textual material (printed or written), notes, plastic pouch, calculator, pen, writing pad, pen drives, eraser, etc. · Any electronic device like mobile phone, bluetooth, earphones, microphone, pager, wrist watch/health band/smart watch, calculator, electronic pen/scanner etc. · All ornaments like bracelets, ring, earrings, nose-pin, chain/ necklace, pendants, necklace with pendants, badge, brooch etc. Items carried due to religious beliefs, if any, shall only be permitted after thorough examination. · Other items like wallet, goggles, handbags, belt, cap, water bottle etc. · Any edible item opened or packed, soft drinks, water bottle etc. · Any other item which could be used for unfair means, for hiding communication devices like wireless/Bluetooth device, spy camera etc. · In case candidates need to carry medicines or a medical equipments, they must carry supportive medical documents such as prescriptions or reports.

faqs.question: My name is spelt incorrectly in NEET SS admit card. What should I do?
faqs.answer: If you have spelt your name correctly in application form of NEET SS and it is still misspelled on admit card, you must contact office of NBE to get it corrected. faqs.answer: No. NBE doesn't send NEET SS admit card on email. Candidates have to download the admit card from the official website, nbe.edu.in. According to NBEMS, failure to submit images as per guidelines and/or failure to rectify the images shall invite rejection of the application.

faqs.question: Which documents or files have to be uploaded while filling the NEET SS application form?
faqs.answer: While filling NEET SS application form, candidates have to upload following documents or files: Photograph Signature Thumb impression Two separate photographs have to be uploaded. first one has to be a passport-size photograph. second photo has to be clicked on webcam of desktop or laptop while filling form and uploading it. Candidates have to upload documents in given format only, otherwise their NEET SS applications are not accepted.

faqs.question: What should be the format and resolution for uploading signature and thumb impression at the NEET SS application form?
faqs.answer: Candidates need to upload the documents on the NEET SS application form. The size of the documents such as signature image and thumb impression should not be more than 80 kb. The scanner needs to be set to 200 dpi. The format should be .jpg or .jpeg. Have a look at the details of the signature image below- It has to be done on a white page within a box in blue/back ballpoint pen. The box size should be 3.5 x 1.5 cm (width x height). The thumb impression needs to be uploaded as per the details shared below- Draw a box of 3.5 cm x 1.5 cm (width & height). Take the thumb impression within the box with blue/ black coloured ink pad.

faqs.question: How will I come to know if I need to make any correction in the NEET SS application form?
faqs.answer: After submitting the NEET SS application form, candidates are advised to go through the submitted form to check whether all the information entered are correct or not. In case there is a mistake, then you have to make the changes in the first NEET SS edit window. In case of a deficient image or signature or thumb impression, NBE will mail candidates with the details and candidates have to edit the images accordingly.

faqs.question: How to be sure if the NEET SS application form has been submitted or not?
faqs.answer: Once the NEET SS application form is submitted, candidates will be sent a confirmation email and an SMS notification confirming the successful completion of the application process. In case candidates submit the NEET SS application form but do not get any confirmation, they are advised to contact NBE to seek the application status. In case they cannot reach out to the NBE officials, they should check whether the NEET SS application fee amount has been deducted on not. Next, they must login to the NEET SS website with their registration credentials and check the status.

faqs.question: What is the difference between the NEET SS primary correction window and final correction window?
faqs.answer: There are two types of NEET SS application correction window. In the first and primary correction window, and the final correction window. In the first or primary NEET SS correction window, candidates can make corrections or changes in the informtion entered in the application form, except for a few fields. On the other hand, in the NEET SS final correction window, candidates will be able to make corrections in the incorrect or deficient images of photograph, signature and thumb impression. Candidates will not be able to make changes in the images in the primary correction window and vice versa.

faqs.question: Does NBE provide correction facility for NEET SS?
faqs.answer: Yes, NBE or the National Board of Examinations in Medical Sciences provides correction facility for NEET SS application form. There are two correction or edit windows provided only for those candidates who submit the application form on time by paying the requisite application fee. The first NEET SS application correction window is for making the basic changes in the application form, in the permitted fields. In the second and the final correction window of NEET SS, candidates are given the opportunity to correct the deficient or incorrect images or files uploaded, such as photograph, signature and thumb impression. Both the NEET SS application correction windows are provided for three days.

faqs.question: What was date for NEET SS 2025 exam?

faqs.question: Is there a fee involved for NEET SS application correction?
faqs.answer: There is no fee involved for editing the NEET SS application form. Only those candidates who completed the NEET SS application process are eligible to avail the edit window. Applicants can make changes in the editable fields only.

faqs.question: Does NBE extend or reopen the NEET SS application window?
faqs.answer: In general, the National Board of Examinations in Medical Sciences (NBEMS), the exam conducting body does not extend on reopen the NEET SS application window. The NEET SS 2024 application dates were announced by NBE on February 4. The application window was scheduled from February 4 to February 24, 2025. Like previous years, NBE has not extended the last date of NEET SS 2024 application process.

faqs.question: What is the duration of the NEET SS application window?
faqs.answer: The NEET SS 2025 application process was carried out for 20 days. The applications were invited from November 5 to 25. Candidates needed to complete the process within the given time and not wait for NBE to extend the last date. The exam was held on December 26 and 27, 2025.

faqs.question: Is Aadhaar card mandatory for NEET SS application process?
faqs.answer: No, it is not mandatory to enter Aadhaar number or other details regarding the Aadhaar card while filling the NEET SS application process. It is one of the accepted identity cards for candidates at the NEET SS exam centres, but their Aadhaar card is not required while filling up the online application form for NEET SS. The NEET SS 2025 application process is yet to begin and NBE might make Aadhaar verification mandatory this year onwards.

faqs.question: How many exam city preferences can I enter in the NEET SS application form?
faqs.answer: In the NEET SS application form, candidates have to select the exam city in a first come first serve basis. Although specific number of cities is not mentioned, it is estimated that candidates will be able to choose up to two cities for the NEET SS exam. Last year, NEET SS was conducted in 36 cities across India. Candidates must choose the city as per their preference. Last year, the total number of exam cities was 55, which has been reduced this year.

faqs.question: Can I fill the NEET SS application form in mobile phone?
faqs.answer: All those who wish to apply for NEET SS 2025 are advised to use a computer for filling the application form. The application form is not compatible with mobile phones and candidates were not able to fill all the details in the form if they try to fill it on mobile phones. Moreover, one of the steps in NEET SS 2025 application form is to click a realtime photo on the webcamera. Filling the application form through mobile phone will hamper this process as uploading selfies is not allowed. Hence, candidates must use a computer or a laptop to fill and submit the NEET SS application form.

faqs.question: I have forgotten my NEET SS login credentials. What should I do?
faqs.answer: Once the NEET SS registration process is successful, NBE sends the login credentials to the registered email ID of the applicant. Candidates must save this email and refer to this if they forget the login credentials. In case they misplace the email as well, they are advised to click on the Forgot User ID/Password tab and then enter their email address and mobile number. A link will be sent for retreiving the username or password. However, candidates are advised to preserve these crucial information right after the generation of the NEET SS credentials.

faqs.question: Can I fill the NEET SS application form in offline mode?
faqs.answer: The application process for NEET SS is completely online. Hence, it is not possible or permitted to fill and submit the NEET SS application form in offline mode. Once the NEET SS application form is released, candidates will have to visit the official website of NBEMS and click on the NEET SS section. Upon reaching the exam portal, they have to click on the 'Application Form' tab and read the instructions carefully before starting the registration and application process. The NEET SS application process will be considered complete only after the exam fee is paid.
